Name: Gigatharion
Information:
**Gigatharion**

**Title** The Sheer Overload

**Gemstone** Rubellite

**Type** Pleromael

**Originator** Copehtor

Originally a Beast of Bestowal elevated to great power by Copehtor, who has now been set free due to Copehtor losing their divine power. Gigatharion was created as an engine of destruction, and so continues to be one for its own purposes. This gargantuan beast is a living meteor, ready to rip apart the world around it at a moment’s notice.

Stat Blocks.title: Gigatharion

traits.name: Charge
traits.description: If Gigatharion moves at least 20 feet in a straight line toward a target, their next attack against them on that turn has advantage. Additionally, if it hits, the target must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw, and is knocked prone on a failure.

traits.name: Cosmic Shard: Rage King Core
traits.description: At the start of Gigatharion’s turn, it creates four Rage King Cores in unoccupied spaces it chooses within 60 feet of it, and it can move existing Rage King Cores up to 30 feet each to a space they choose. It can only have up to ten of these cores active at a time.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Gigatharion makes two Rubellite Claw attacks and one Quartzfire Gore attack.

actions.name: Rubellite Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 6 (1d10) fire damage.

actions.name: Quartzfire Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Blazing Flare
actions.description: Gigatharion roars, and causes each Rage King Core to fire a blast of ruby flame as a Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 6) fire damage. It can only target the same creature with up to half of its Blazing Flare attacks.

actions.name: Behemoth Meteorfall
actions.description: Gigatharion can destroy six or more of their Rage King Cores to send them into the sky, then have them each fall into a point it chooses within 120 feet. A fiery explosion erupts from each, forcing each creature within 30 feet of one or more to make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) fire damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success. Any creature who fails by 10 points or more is ignited for 1 minute, taking a d8 of fire damage at the start of each of their turns.

bonus_actions.name: Taurous Rage
bonus_actions.description: Gigatharion causes two of their Rage King Cores to emit a burst of flame, forcing each creature within 20 feet of one of them to make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. Each creature that fails takes 27 (6d8) fire damage, or half as much on a successful one.

options.name: Charge
options.description: Gigatharion moves up to half its movement speed then makes a single Quartzfire Gore attack.

options.name: Rage Burst (Costs 2 Actions)
options.description: One of Gigatharion’s Rage King Cores moves into an unoccupied space within 30 feet, then each core uses their Blazing Flare against a target within range.

options.name: Seismic Quake (Costs 2 Actions)
options.description: Gigatharion causes the area around it to shake, forcing each creature on the ground within 30 feet of it to make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. Each that fails takes 7 (2d6) fire damage and falls prone.
